browser_review.scope: Changed native assemblies visually reviewed in the in-app browser. Responsive viewport review is separate from real mobile touch and external Chrome certification.

scope: Actual exported mesh quality for all 61 available machines, scoped sampled motion/native reference reviews and loaded combination audits. Native assembly references, unregistered routing and unverified mounting interfaces retain their declared limitations. Every physical clearance and every browser/device are not certified.

interaction_review.scope: Draft selection, atomic apply, cancel, retry and undo. Model catalogs, geometry, resolver and motion adapters are unchanged; 52 prior scoped native reviews are retained. Actual exported-model/combination audits rerun with this source checkout. No new physical fit certification.

interaction_review.retention_scope: Upstream draft controls retained; complete source regressions rerun after English/default-language integration. Actual model review is separately refreshed for this release.

loading_review.scope: Current production loaders, measured progress, checksum identity and cleanup; GPU rendering is separate.

mesh_rebuild_review.scope: All 719 exported SV08 parts compared against native tessellation: triangles, coordinates, bounds and normals; no decimation.

belt_winding_review.scope: V2.4 and Monolith swept belt face orientation and signed volume at moving poses. Source belt omissions and physical tension are not certified.
